subject: GTM: Squad staffing contingency request - EMEA field coverage
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 08:32:00 +0000
Subject: GTM: Squad staffing contingency request - EMEA field coverage

Hi team,

Quick summary / ask: Acme Analytics has expanded scope on their Q1 rollout and the customer success plan now requires dedicated Solutions Engineering support across DACH + Nordics starting in January. To avoid delivery risk and revenue slippage, I’m requesting approval to open 3 additional go-to-market requisitions for EMEA coverage: 2 Solutions Engineers (L2 / senior IC) and 1 Account Executive (quota-carrying, EMEA mid-market).

Why now:
- Acme committed to a multi-region rollout; delivery timeline can’t shift.
- Current SE on the account is single-threaded and at capacity for handoffs.
- If we don’t add cover, we risk delaying go-live and losing renewal / expansion potential (~$1.1M ARR).

Proposal (high level):
- Headcount: 2x SE (FTE), 1x AE (either FTE or 6-month contractor while we validate motion)
- Target start: earliest onboard Jan 18 (EMEA timezone hires)
- Suggested comp bands (EMEA): SE: £85k–£120k total comp; AE: £75k–£110k OTE (dependent on experience). Detailed comp bands attached.
- Hiring approach: prioritize SE hires as direct FTE; AE as contingent hire if approval timelines push past Dec 20.

Budget impact: preliminary model attached (headcount-cost-model.xlsx). Rough FY27 incremental run-rate (if FTE): ~£650–780k fully loaded.

Attachments: SE_EU-JD.pdf, headcount-cost-model.xlsx, comp-bands-EMEA.csv

Asks:
1) Can leadership sign off to open requisitions for 2 SE FTEs and conditional approval for 1 AE (contingent on final comp)?
2) If yes, do we need VP or CFO-level approval for the spend bucket I noted? Please advise approver chain.
3) Marissa: can recruiting open a Greenhouse req and start outreach to TalentHub while we finalize comp bands?

I can be on a quick sync this afternoon if easier.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Field Coverage (EMEA) | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +44 7700 123456

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 12:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: GTM: Squad staffing contingency request - EMEA field coverage

Olga — thanks for the context and the clear ask. In principle I support moving faster on this; two operational notes:

1) Prioritization: please prioritize the two SE hires over the AE. SE capacity gap is the gating factor for the rollout. If we can onboard two SEs by mid-Jan we can use an existing AE for cover for 6–8 weeks.
2) Comp bands: need ranges in local currency and an expected offer midpoint for each level (so we can finalize total comp and offer authority).

Can you please update the attached sheet with expected midpoints and whether relocation/visa support is required? I’m OK with conditional approval for 2 FTE SEs today, subject to finance confirmation on run rate. The AE can be contractor-first if recruiting can source quickly.

If you think this needs a 15-min review, I’m available at 15:30 UTC today.

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales (EMEA) | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Subject: Re: GTM: Squad staffing contingency request - EMEA field coverage

Thanks for the heads-up, Olga. A few clarifying Qs before we open reqs:

- Are these net-new FTEs (headcount add) or backfills/reallocation? (affects org budget code)
- Remote eligibility / must-have locations? Visa sponsorship needed?
- Do you have finalized JDs for the SE roles for recruiting to start outreach? If not, I can work with you to adapt the Acme-specific JD you attached.

Recruiting process: I’ll put this on the EMEA priority queue once I have confirmation on FTE vs contractor and the exact comp midpoint. We can also run a parallel contractor search with TalentHub; they have narrow-window candidates for Jan starts. Their recruiter is sarah.hale@acme-analytics.com (cc me if you want TalentHub engaged).

I’ve added the preliminary request to the staffing tracker: https://notion.redwood.com/GTMSquadCoverage/EMEA-Staffing-Tracker — please update the expected start date and JD link there.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Talent Partner | People Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.com

On Sat, Dec 5, 2026 at 12:15 Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 09:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: GTM: Squad staffing contingency request - EMEA field coverage

Appreciate the detail — ran a quick cost check based on the attached workbook. High-level:

- 2x SE FTE (midpoint £100k each) + benefits & taxes => incremental FY27 run-rate ~£420k.
- 1x AE FTE (OTE £95k) => incremental ~£220k.
- Contractor AE (6 months) => ~£60–75k (benchmarks from TalentHub).

Recommendation (finance): Approve 2x SE FTEs now (low risk given ARR at stake). Convert AE to 6-month contractor while we validate revenue motion — that reduces FY27 cash requirement by ~£140–160k.

Approval path: anything within the FY27 headcount budget up to £500k incremental can be approved by VP (Vivek). Anything above needs CFO sign-off. With the SE-only ask we are within VP approval. If we push AE as FTE now, that pushes us into CFO review.

If you want, I can prepare a short one-pager for CFO review if the team prefers FTE AE. Otherwise, proceed with two SE requisitions and a contractor order for the AE.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance, GTM | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Subject: Re: GTM: Squad staffing contingency request - EMEA field coverage

Thanks all — quick update and revised ask following feedback.

Decision summary (revised):
- Approve 2x SE as FTEs (EMEA L2 / senior IC). I will prioritize candidates who are remote in EU timezones; minimal visa needs.
- Approve 1x AE as a 6-month contractor (TalentHub engaged) with a conditional FTE conversion after Q2 cadence review.

Updated comp midpoints (entered into the workbook & attached):
- SE (L2): £102,500 midpoint (range £85k–£120k)
- AE (contractor): equivalent OTE £90k (contractor rate used for P&L modeling)

Next steps I will take:
1) Marissa: please open two Greenhouse reqs (SE - RED-EMEA-042 and RED-EMEA-043) with the JDs attached.
2) Recruiting: kick TalentHub for contractor candidates (sarah.hale@talenthub.io).
3) Finance: Rishi, please confirm payroll code and I’ll route requisition to Vivek for sign-off in Greenhouse.
4) Ops: I’ll update the Notion staffing tracker and attach the JD and cost model.

Attachments: SE_EU-JD.pdf, headcount-cost-model.xlsx, comp-bands-EMEA.csv

Approvals requested: Vivek — please confirm you’ll sign the two SE requisitions in Greenhouse (I will tag you once the reqs are ready). Rishi — please confirm VP approval threshold is sufficient and provide the payroll code to use. Marissa — greenlight to run TalentHub in parallel and open the two reqs.

If no objections by EOD Monday (Dec 7), I’ll instruct recruiting to open reqs and TalentHub outreach.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
